cases.refreshed: Get into the Holiday spirit by learning some Holiday-inspired songs on the Ukulele! Participants are invited to this fun and educational 2-part series of 1-hour Ukulele lessons. We will learn the basics of reading chords and strumming techniques through familiar songs. This series will take place on 2 dates and will cover the following: November 10: Introduce the parts of the ukulele, how to hold the instrument, and how to read chords. November 17: Combine learned chords with strumming patterns and put it all together by playing songs. No prior music ability required. Ukuleles will be provided to participants. If you have your own ukulele, you may bring it in for this program. Recommended for ages 10 and Up. Free. Registration Required.
